test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they do not conform to real-world knowledge, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

Statements:

1. All buildings are shops.

2. Some shops are boutiques.

3. No restaurant is a boutique.

Conclusions:

I. Some boutiques are buildings.

II. Some restaurants being buildings is a possibility.

III. No restaurant is a shop.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
__**Least Possible Venn diagrams**__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74aecdcdcb9662d8e048c097360fe37ecf777adde80fbba91d1fd7c4c825abb7.png] 

**Conclusions: **

**I. **Some boutiques are buildings → **Doesn't Follow **(As some shops are boutiques and all buildings are shops, so we can not say anything definite about some boutiques are building.it is a possibility)

This possibility scenario can be shown using the below Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30e507f08836ffcbe3eb949dca0c27d5d8b9a053243b7810389ba3cb3c0a3fbf.png] 

Here, No boutique is a building. that is why this statement is a possibility. 

**II. **Some restaurants being buildings is a possibility →** Follow **(As no restaurant is a boutique , some boutique are shops and all buildings are shops. so we can not say anything about some restaurants are building,** it is a possibility **)

This possibility scenario can be shown using the below Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da96a0a9d9a34cc06c83b198e2670e84e9822ab7669f8072680cd3c22b8cd235.png] 

Here, some buildings are restaurants that's why this given possibility is followed.

**III**. No restaurant is a shop → **Doesn't Follow **(As some boutiques are shops and no boutique is a restaurant, so Some part of restaurant is not shop, but No restaurant is a shop can be possible only)

Thus, **Only conclusion II follows**.

Hence,** **the correct answer is " Only conclusion II follows".
